title: a restaurant pos for the laptop you have.

items.title: the laptop is the server
items.body: install torta on mac, windows or linux. the menu, every order and the sales history stay on that laptop.

items.title: tablets and phones take orders
items.body: any device on the same wifi opens a link from the laptop. nothing to install.

items.title: works without internet
items.body: ordering and the kitchen run over your own wifi. a binary garden account is optional.

items.title: pair with a code
items.body: scan a qr code or type a six-digit code. remove a device to revoke it.

items.title: live kitchen screen
items.body: orders reach the kitchen the moment they are sent, on any tablet.

items.title: free and open source
items.body: agpl licensed. read the code, change it, run it.
